name: Freshdesk
description: Freshdesk is a cloud customer-support platform for ticketing, team inboxes, automation, knowledge bases, reporting, and omnichannel service. Support teams use it to organize requests, collaborate on resolutions, manage service workflows, and track performance.
agentUseSummary: Enter your Freshdesk domain and personal API key once, then let agents read tickets or use the complete key-authorized API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHDESK_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Freshdesk domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the part before .freshdesk.com in your Freshdesk address.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHDESK_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Freshdesk API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy your own API key from your Freshdesk profile. Its access follows your Freshdesk agent role.

capabilities.label: Read support tickets
capabilities.description: List bounded ticket pages and read individual tickets from the connected Freshdesk account.

capabilities.label: Full Freshdesk API
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented Freshdesk API v2 surface allowed by the connected agent's role and API key.

allowed.label: List tickets
allowed.description: List one bounded page of tickets from the connected Freshdesk account.

allowed.label: Read ticket
allowed.description: Read one ticket by its Freshdesk ID.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Freshdesk API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Freshdesk API v2 operation authorized by the connected agent API key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded ticket reads run directly; every other Freshdesk API operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected API-key-authorized Freshdesk operation runs without Relay per-action approval; account ownership, exact tenant binding, secret isolation, request bounds, audits, provider roles, and Freshdesk limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: The backend mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted customer key only to the exact Freshdesk account.
The backend mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted customer key only to the exact Freshdesk account.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Freshdesk domain and personal agent API key are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer enters the domain and API key, then Relay verifies the account, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation, key reset, and disconnect behavior.

evidence.supports: The official Freshdesk API v2 reference documents Basic authentication with a personal API key, exact account-domain API origins, ticket and administration endpoints, pagination, role-based authority, and rate limits.
Freshdesk documents where an agent finds and resets their personal API key in the profile settings.
Freshworks staff state that the Freshdesk API supports Basic authentication with an API key rather than OAuth.
